name: Capital Maritime Finance Corp.
summary: Capital Maritime Finance Corp., through its subsidiaries, engages in the seaborne transportation of containers in Marshall Islands and internationally. The company contains 10 dual-fuel LNG vessels. It operates in the container ship chartering market that caters to liner companies and transport companies. Capital Maritime Finance Corp. was formerly known as Capital Container Carriers Corp. and changed its name to Capital Maritime Finance Corp. in July 2026. The company was incorporated in 2025 and is based in Piraeus, Greece. Capital Maritime Finance Corp operates as a subsidiary of Capital Maritime & Trading Corp.
